Fixed `recipent` → `recipient` in `services/notifier/migrations/202609011200_create_outbox.sql` (line 4). It was the only occurrence in the repo.

I edited the file in place instead of adding a new migration. The notifier hasn't launched and none of its migrations has been applied to a shared database, so an in-place edit is safe until the planned 2026-11 launch. The "never edit an applied migration" rule covers other migrations, not these.
